sentences.en: PRESENTER: The children's book festival is coming up again soon and here to tell us all about it is the festival's organiser, Jenny Morgan.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 儿童图书节即将再次举行，今天来到我们节目为大家介绍相关情况的是该节的组织者珍妮·摩根。

sentences.en: So tell us what we can expect this year, Jenny.
sentences.zh: 那么，请告诉我们今年大家都能期待些什么，珍妮。

sentences.en: JENNY: Well, as usual we've got five days of action-packed exciting events for children, with writers coming from all over the country getting involved.
sentences.zh: JENNY: 嗯，和往年一样，我们将举办为期五天、内容丰富、激动人心的儿童活动，来自全国各地的作家都将参与其中。

sentences.en: Just to give you an idea of what's on offer in the workshops, first of all, there's a very special event called Superheroes.
sentences.zh: 先简单介绍一下工作坊提供的活动：首先是一场名为《超级英雄》的特别活动。

sentences.en: This is a chance for deaf children to share their reading experiences with author Madeleine Gordon, who is herself hearing impaired.
sentences.zh: 这为听障儿童提供了机会，让他们能与同样有听力障碍的作家玛德琳·戈登分享自己的阅读体验。

sentences.en: 'Just do it' is a practical workshop led by the well-known illustrator Mark Keane.
sentences.zh: 《立即行动》是由著名插画家马克·基恩主持的一场实践性工作坊。

sentences.en: a He'll take participants on a magical journey to faraway lands with an opportunity for aspiring actors to do some role play.
sentences.zh: 他将带领参与者踏上一段通往遥远国度的奇妙旅程，并为有志成为演员的孩子提供角色扮演的机会。

sentences.en: 'Count on me' is an inspiring and entertaining look at the issues of friendship for 13-14-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 《信赖我》是一场鼓舞人心又富有趣味性的活动，聚焦于13至14岁青少年的友谊议题。

sentences.en: It looks at some of the friendships described in popular books and asks participants to compare these with their own experiences.
sentences.zh: 它探讨了若干流行书籍中所描写的友谊，并请参与者将自己的亲身经历与之进行比较。

sentences.en: Speak up' is part of a series of workshops on the subject of mental health.
sentences.zh: 《大声说出来》是围绕心理健康主题开展的一系列工作坊之一。

sentences.en: This is a creative writing workshop encouraging children to describe situations where young people experience loneliness.
sentences.zh: 这是一场创意写作工作坊，鼓励孩子们描述青少年感到孤独的各种情境。

sentences.en: A recent survey revealed that children can be lonely even when they're at home with their families.
sentences.zh: 最近一项调查显示，即便孩子与家人同住家中，也可能会感到孤独。

sentences.en: 'Jump for joy', as many of you will know, is the heart-warming, best-selling story by Nina Karan about young girl's trip to visit her relatives in India.
sentences.zh: 《跃动欢欣》——正如你们许多人所知——是尼娜·卡拉恩创作的温暖人心、畅销一时的故事，讲述了一位小女孩前往印度探望亲戚的经历。

sentences.en: It recently received the gold medal at the Waterford Awards.
sentences.zh: 该书最近荣获沃特福德奖的金奖。

sentences.en: Nina will get children to celebrate the word 'joy' by writing a poem.
sentences.zh: 尼娜将引导孩子们围绕‘欢欣’一词创作一首诗。

sentences.en: 'Sticks and stones' is the beautifully illustrated picture book for young readers about a community who organise an African-Caribbean festival to help local children learn about their Jamaican roots.
sentences.zh: 《棍棒与石头》是一本图文并茂、精美绝伦的图画书，面向年幼读者，讲述了一个社区如何组织一场非洲—加勒比文化节，以帮助当地儿童了解自己的牙买加文化根源。

sentences.en: This will be a musical event where children will have the chance to play steel drums.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场音乐活动，孩子们将有机会演奏钢鼓。

sentences.en: This is bound to be is very popular, so please book as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 这势必会非常受欢迎，因此请务必尽早预订。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: Thanks Jenny.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 谢谢你，珍妮。

sentences.en: That all sounds really interesting.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实非常有趣。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering if you have a favourite book you could recommend for our readers?
sentences.zh: 我正想问问，您能否向我们的读者推荐一本您最喜爱的书？

sentences.en: JENNY: It's hard to choose, but Alive and Kicking is definitely worth mentioning.
sentences.zh: JENNY: 很难抉择，但《生机勃勃》绝对值得推荐。

sentences.en: You won't have heard of the writer as it's her first book - which iS really impressive.
sentences.zh: 你们可能没听说过这位作者，因为这是她的处女作——而这恰恰令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: It's basically the teenage diary of a boy from Somalia who comes to live in the UK.
sentences.zh: 这本书本质上是一位来自索马里的少年在英国生活的日记。

sentences.en: It deals with the serious issue of immigration and all the challenges the boy has /18 to face at school and with the language barrier, etc.
sentences.zh: 它探讨了移民这一严肃议题，以及这位少年在学校及语言障碍等方面所面临的种种挑战。

sentences.en: Usually, books like this are quite sad, but this one actually made me cry with laughter.
sentences.zh: 通常这类书籍读起来相当伤感，但这本却让我笑出了眼泪。

sentences.en: On each page, there /18 are simple but hilarious black and white stick drawings of the boy with his friends and teachers.
sentences.zh: 每一页上都有简单却令人捧腹的黑白简笔画，描绘了这位少年与朋友及老师相处的情景。

sentences.en: At the end of each diary entry, there are new English words the boy learns each day, which may help develop some children's vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 每篇日记结尾处都列出了少年当天学到的新英语单词，或许有助于拓展部分孩子的词汇量。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: I think my kids would enjoy that.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 我觉得我的孩子们会很喜欢这本书。

sentences.en: What about any advice for parents on how to encourage their children to read more?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于家长如何鼓励孩子多读书，您有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: JENNY: Well, this is something I get asked about a lot.
sentences.zh: JENNY: 这是我经常被问到的问题。

sentences.en: There are so many distractions for kids these days that it can be hard to find time for reading.
sentences.zh: 如今孩子们面临太多干扰，很难抽出时间来阅读。

sentences.en: One thing I'd say is to make time to sit down with your child and share books with them.
sentences.zh: 我想强调的一点是：务必腾出时间，坐下来与孩子共读图书。

sentences.en: A lot of parents give up reading aloud to their children as soon as they learn to read independently, but this is a mistake.
sentences.zh: 许多家长一旦孩子能独立阅读，便不再为他们朗读，但这其实是个错误。

sentences.en: It's good to read more advanced books to them as it helps to develop their vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 为孩子朗读难度稍高的书籍很有益处，有助于拓展他们的词汇量。

sentences.en: If you don't have time for this, then let them listen to audio books.
sentences.zh: 如果实在抽不出时间，那就让孩子听有声书。

sentences.en: Often, they'll want to read books they've listened /20 to for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们往往会在听过之后，主动去阅读自己曾听过的那些书。

sentences.en: I think it's to a good idea to make a mental note of the type of books your child is reading - often they just read the same genre all the time, which can get a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 我认为，最好在心里记下孩子正在阅读的书籍类型——因为他们常常只读同一类题材，久而久之难免乏味。

sentences.en: You can introduce new authors and genres to them.
sentences.zh: 您可以为他们引入新的作家和新的体裁。

sentences.en: /20 Librarians should be able to help you with this.
sentences.zh: 图书馆员应该能在这方面为您提供帮助。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: Well Jenny, I think that's really useful.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 嗯，珍妮，我觉得这真的很有用。
